title: PakBBQ: A Culturally Adapted Bias Benchmark for QA
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a benchmark (PakBBQ) that includes 'Religion' as one of its eight core bias dimensions. It specifically examines social biases related to religious affiliations and sectarianism within the Pakistani context (e.g., Islam, Christians, Hindus, Ahmadis) and includes specific templates and evaluation results for religious bias across multiple LLMs.
